title: Slovakian Pork Dumplings
description: A hearty Slovakian dish featuring pork dumplings in a rich broth.

ingredients.name: Dumpling dough
ingredients.notes: For homemade, combine 2 cups all-purpose flour, 1/4 cup warm water, 1/4 teaspoon salt

instructions: Bring beef broth to a boil in a large pot.
Add pork pieces and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add chopped onion, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper. Cook until onion is softened, about 3 minutes.
Add dumpling dough, breaking it up into small pieces as you add it. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 10-15 minutes.
Stir in melted butter and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
